line_definition: awk record count (NR) over exact Git blob bytes; blank and comment lines count; a nonempty final record counts without requiring a trailing LF
byte_definition: Git blob byte length from git cat-file -s
manifest_entry_definition: UTF-8 path, TAB, byte length, TAB, physical line count, TAB, lowercase SHA-256 of exact blob bytes, LF; entries sorted by Git path
direct_runtime_dependency_source: pyproject.toml project.dependencies at the bound commit
